claims.claim: CMI identity/tradability is validated as Cummins Inc. common stock on NYSE, CIK 0000026172; current packet lineage contains three unique primary origins after duplicate-origin collapse.

Fresh Q2 2026 SEC/issuer evidence confirms $3.924B cash and marketable securities, $1.808B six-month operating cash flow, 35.6% debt-to-capital and $3.652B revolving-credit capacity; evidence is consistent with the packet's operating narrative.
A current September 2026 independent market source reports CMI market capitalization near $74B and P/E near 27x, supplying a lawful valuation input distinct from issuer evidence.

risks.risk: Issuer and SEC earnings materials share company-origin facts and are not treated as independent corroboration of issuer claims.

unknowns.unknown: Current disclosures do not isolate data-center customer concentration or incremental margin contribution.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $9.5B, up 9% year over year; management raised 2026 revenue-growth guidance to 10%-13% and EBITDA-margin guidance to 18.0%-18.5%, while Q2 EBITDA margin of 17.5% remained below the prior-year 18.4%.
Six-month 2026 operating cash flow rose to $1.808B from $782M; June liquidity was $3.924B cash/marketable securities plus $3.652B revolving capacity, while debt-to-capital was 35.6%.

Power Systems sales rose 19% with data-center demand a major driver, but Accelera remained loss-making and broad open purchase orders can be cancellable, limiting confidence in headline demand durability.

September 2026 market evidence near $74B market capitalization and ~27x trailing earnings is demanding versus historical industrial valuations, tempering valuation-opportunity scoring despite strong execution.

risks.risk: Truck/off-highway cyclicality can offset data-center power strength; Accelera losses and cancellable open orders reduce demand-quality certainty.
Valuation around 27x trailing earnings embeds substantial execution and growth expectations.

contradictions.contradiction: Record revenue and raised guidance coexist with lower year-over-year Q2 EBITDA margin.

unknowns.unknown: Data-center customer concentration, backlog economics and incremental margins are not separately disclosed.

thesisQuality.basis: Strong multi-segment power franchise and accelerating data-center demand support durable adoption, but concentration/backlog economics remain undisclosed, keeping the value-capture case below exceptional.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Record $9.5B Q2 revenue, raised annual guidance, $1.808B six-month operating cash flow and ample liquidity are strong; lower year-over-year Q2 EBITDA margin and Accelera losses cap the score.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Market capitalization near $74B and roughly 27x trailing earnings indicate a demanding valuation after a strong share-price run; supported growth exists but downside-adjusted headroom is not clearly compelling.

catalystScore.basis: Raised 2026 revenue/EBITDA guidance and data-center-driven Power Systems growth are material source-supported catalysts with identifiable current-year timing, but cyclical offsets remain.

governancePower.basis: Board-authorized 10% dividend increase, ongoing repurchases and improving debt-to-capital demonstrate shareholder returns and balance-sheet discipline; evidence does not justify exceptional stewardship.

alignment2036.basis: Critical power for data centers plus diversified engine, components, distribution and zero-emission pathways create strong long-duration infrastructure relevance across multiple transition paths.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Five operating segments and a global manufacturing/service network reuse power-system, component and distribution capabilities across data centers, transport and industrial markets.

bottleneckControl.basis: Data-center critical-power demand and installed service capability create meaningful constraint participation, but grid, permitting and generator supply chains remain successor bottlenecks and no evidence proves singular control.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Diversified engine, power systems, components, distribution and Accelera pathways provide resilience across transition speeds, though truck/off-highway cyclicality remains material.

substitutionResilience.basis: Broad multi-technology portfolio, global service network and transition investments create replacement barriers and adaptation capacity, but generator and powertrain alternatives remain credible.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Global manufacturing and liquidity support resilience, but current evidence does not demonstrate exceptional multi-source redundancy and identifies grid/supply constraints around deployment.

pricingPower.basis: Strong absolute EBITDA and raised margin guidance indicate some economic capture, but Q2 margin declined year over year and disclosures do not isolate data-center pricing or incremental margins.

riskEvidence.basis: Moderate risk from cyclical truck/off-highway exposure, lower year-over-year Q2 margin, Accelera losses, cancellable open orders and a demanding current valuation; strong liquidity reduces survival risk.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Recent SEC 10-Q, issuer earnings release, annual filing and proxy cover operations, liquidity, governance and risks; independent current market data covers valuation. Remaining undisclosed data-center concentration/margin detail is non-gating but reduces confidence.

scoreRecord.thesis: Cummins combines a durable global power franchise with accelerating data-center critical-power demand and multi-technology transition optionality, supported by strong liquidity and current operating momentum; valuation and cyclical/transition drag constrain upside asymmetry.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: A demanding valuation can compress if data-center growth fails to offset truck/off-highway cyclicality, margin pressure and continued Accelera losses.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Execution against raised 2026 revenue growth and EBITDA-margin guidance, especially Power Systems/data-center demand and second-half margin conversion.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore is the methodology-weighted component score; risk and confidence are separately source-addressed for downstream runtime-gate treatment.
